name: אַשּׁוּר
summary: Genesis names Asshur as a son of Shem, and Asshur is also the land of Assyria, east of which the Hiddekel flows. The derivation of the name is uncertain.

evidence.note: The heading בְּנֵי שֵׁם identifies Asshur and the others listed as sons of Shem.
קִדְמַת אַשּׁוּר means “east of Asshur” and describes where the third river flows.

note: Merged with the former word entry `2axxwwr`, the place word (old root key אשור, the consonants of the place name), which added Assyria@Gen.2.14. Its derivation is uncertain.
